svg.title: One line down
svg.desc: Page 2: One line down. Leila and Jonah inspect the stopped circulation pump. The processing line is safely isolated. A machine status display separates the stopped industrial line from normal residential supplies. Leila weighs an overhaul against a replacement assembly.
